versions.subject: feat: rules update
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\VSDiagnostics.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'VSDiagnostics.exe'
selection_cli_start:
    CommandLine|contains: 'start'
selection_cli_launch:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /launch:'
        - ' -launch:'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\VSDiagnostics.exe" OR OriginalFileName="VSDiagnostics.exe" CommandLine="*start*" CommandLine IN ("* /launch:*", "* -launch:*")
